description: This file contains internal utility functions for linear algebra operations in PyTorch, including tensor type checks, matrix multiplication, eigenvalue computations, and deprecated function stubs.

methods.name: is_sparse
methods.description: Checks if a tensor is a sparse COO tensor.

methods.name: get_floating_dtype
methods.description: Returns the floating point dtype of a tensor, mapping integer types to float32.

methods.name: matmul
methods.description: Performs matrix multiplication, handling None and sparse tensors.

methods.name: bform
methods.description: Computes the bilinear form X^T A Y.

methods.name: qform
methods.description: Computes the quadratic form S^T A S.

methods.name: basis
methods.description: Returns an orthogonal basis of the columns of A.

methods.name: symeig
methods.description: Returns eigenpairs of A with specified ordering.
